description: Land Acquisition - Bokanorawa, Kaudaketiya D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain plots of land are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, plot numbers, sizes, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (S. M. Chandrasena, Minister of Lands), this is incidental to the main purpose of the notice, which is land acquisition - making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or hybrid classification.
